wp_items.title: Choosing a facility
wp_items.yoast_title: Choosing a Facility | Toronto Addiction Help Centre

blocks.text: There are many drug and alcohol addiction treatment and rehab facilities across Canada. Although they share the same intent – to help people overcome their addictions to drugs and alcohol – the services they provide can be quite varied. Everyone has different needs when it comes to addiction recovery. This list of questions is designed to help you determine what kind of facility is right for you.
blocks.html: There are many drug and alcohol addiction treatment and rehab facilities across Canada. Although they share the same intent – to help people overcome their addictions to drugs and alcohol – the services they provide can be quite varied. Everyone has different needs when it comes to addiction recovery. This list of questions is designed to help you determine what kind of facility is right for you.

blocks.text: These questions can help you determine whether you are a candidate for inpatient rehab, whether medical detox is needed, what kind of family therapy you might need, and other things.
